about: credits engine style coin with a small dev buy through the stack's ArtCoinsUniv4EthDevBuyV2: 0.01 eth buys the new coin from its own pool in the launch tx. extensions[0].data is abi.encode(recipient, refundRecipient, minOut) with recipient and refundRecipient both the launcher placeholder (0x7ea5...0001) and minOut 1; compute a real minOut from the pool curve before a broadcast. msgValue is wei and is added to the deploy fee as the deployToken value. Replace every placeholder (0x7ea5...0001) and set example to false before a broadcast.

mev.note: startingSkimBps and windowSeconds are required when a mev module is set
